description: A small company rents out its vehicles by the day.
data: vehicles with a number plate (unique), a model and a daily rate
rentals of a vehicle with the customer's name, start date, end date, the total price and whether it has been returned
actions: the manager adds and removes vehicles
rules: a vehicle cannot be rented twice for overlapping dates
the end date must be after the start date
a rental cannot start in the past
the total is the daily rate times the number of days
